editorial.blurb: This genuine Mexican spot serves expertly crafted tacos, burritos, and tortas with homemade tortillas and housemade salsas that keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Bring cash only and dine in to get complimentary chips and salsa at the table; their carne asada burrito is massive enough for two meals, so split one with a friend to stretch your budget.
